data.explanation: This is a closing bill from your electricity provider because you moved out of Lindenweg 12. It settles extra usage and the base fee for the period, totaling EUR 105.58. You need to pay this amount by the deadline shown (30 days after the invoice date) to the provider's bank account. If you disagree with the amount, contact Stadtwerke Musterstadt directly using the details on the invoice, as no formal appeal procedure is stated. If unpaid, expect reminders and possibly late-payment charges, though none are mentioned yet.
